The program parses the input with a fast custom number reader and fits the model with blocked Householder QR on centred data. It never forms the normal equations, and an explicit intercept column keeps the fit exact. Running `node check.mjs` passes all 3 example cases.

- **Large input:** at the maximum size (n = 1,000,000, k = 20, a 156 MB file), `./app` takes about 2.3 s. Its coefficients and R² match Julia's built-in least-squares solver.
- **Speed fix:** I set the maths library to one
